claims.claim: Southern Copper's Q2 filing showed record net sales and earnings driven primarily by sharply higher copper and by-product prices even though copper sales volume declined 1.5% year over year.
Tía María was 42% complete at June 30 with production still expected in 2H27, while the broader capital program creates a material future supply-growth path if projects execute.

factors.name: copper scarcity exposure
factors.basis: Current earnings show strong sensitivity to higher copper prices.

factors.name: project pipeline
factors.basis: Tía María and other projects can expand supply but require multi-year capital and execution.

risks.risk: Record earnings were heavily price-assisted while copper volumes declined, so commodity-price reversal can overwhelm operating progress.

unknowns.unknown: Future project schedule, permitting, social acceptance and realized capex remain execution variables.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 net sales were $4.289B, up 40.6%, and attributable net income was $1.670B, up 71.6%, despite lower sales volumes across copper and several by-products.
The company secured $1.25B of 10-year debt at 5.35% primarily to support Tía María and its capital program, adding funding visibility alongside future fixed obligations.

factors.name: operating leverage to metals
factors.basis: Higher realized metal prices translated into much faster earnings growth than cost growth.

factors.name: capital-program burden
factors.basis: Debt funding supports project execution but adds fixed financing commitments before new production arrives.

risks.risk: Commodity prices, mine grades, project execution and jurisdictional factors can materially alter expected cash generation.

contradictions.claim: Record financial results occurred alongside lower copper sales volume.
contradictions.resolution: The filing attributes the financial acceleration mainly to higher realized metal prices; volume weakness remains a real counter-signal.

unknowns.unknown: No Scout valuation conclusion is asserted from commodity-cycle earnings alone.
